title: Difference Quotient of the Reciprocal Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For f(x)=1/x, simplify the difference quotient (f(x+h)-f(x))/h with h != 0.

steps.title: Write the Numerator as Fraction Difference
steps.explanation: Substituting x+h and x into the reciprocal rule gives two fractions whose difference is the numerator.

steps.title: Combine Over a Common Denominator
steps.explanation: The common denominator is x(x+h); the numerators combine to x-(x+h) = -h.
steps.why: Subtracting fractions requires a shared denominator.

steps.title: Divide by h and Cancel
steps.explanation: Dividing by h cancels the factor h in the numerator, leaving the simplified result.
